supersedes: Initial supports_32_bit_apps=true inferred from generic ramdisk properties; that inference was not device-specific evidence.
property_loading_rule: PropertyLoadBootDefaults collects into a map, allowing later values to override ro.* too; vendor is loaded before ODM, then product. ABI selection prefers product, ODM, vendor, system.
compile_abi_source: source/build/make/core/board_config.mk:370-401 builds ABI32 only when TARGET_SUPPORTS_32_BIT_APPS=true; TARGET_2ND_ARCH can remain for native builds.
custom_vendor_init_override: No custom vendor init library is configured in this device tree. The current source default vendor_load_properties is weak and empty. Built init/runtime overrides still require verification; recovery properties are not normal Android proof.
